result: Fixed active LLM workload yielding when ASR remains behind after capture ends/pauses or during file import.

production_failure.cause: ASR lag accumulated only while recording=true. Capture completion/pause and imports leave recording=false with transcribing=true, so an already-running translation/minutes worker could continue occupying resources despite sustained ASR backlog.
production_failure.why_scheduler_did_not_fix_it: The scheduler skips busy LLM work; its transcribing/backlog admission check prevents later work but cannot stop an already-running worker.
production_failure.original_behavior_red: Existing production decision extracted without behavioral changes; two regressions fail under recording-only logic, including a real child remaining unselected for an ASR stop. All child processes are cleaned before failed assertions.

change: Include recording OR transcribing when accumulating ASR backlog.

Keep the existing strictly greater than 4000 ms lag, six consecutive 500 ms watchdog samples, explicit-cancel priority and bounded owned-child stop/reap path. No new threads, locks, models or thresholds.
Preserve backlog count across capture-to-pause transition; reset only after actual catch-up or no active capture/transcription.

Equivalent De Morgan rewrite of terminology::phrase::full_boundary fixes a strict Clippy finding in the preexisting expression. Character boundaries, short-circuit order and iterator consumption are unchanged.

tested_states: Live capture with sustained ASR lag: stop accepted and confirmed exit.
Capture ended/import with transcribing=true: stop accepted and confirmed exit.
Paused capture with transcribing=true: stop accepted and confirmed exit.
ASR complete with stale elapsed/processed timestamps: no stop; child alive before explicit test cleanup.
Paused ASR with exactly 4000 ms lag: no stop; child alive before explicit test cleanup.
additional_controls: Five live backlog samples followed by paused capture still stop on the sixth sample.
Catch-up resets the count before the next backlog period.
Processed time ahead of elapsed does not underflow into a false backlog.
regression_scope.ownership: Uses production workload decision, finish_watchdog_stop, Server::try_wait, retained lease lifecycle and independent ReapProbe. Existing stopped-child/new-owner/return-to-pool regressions remain green.

limits: Watchdog snapshots are advanced directly in the regression, not by a real microphone/file import or wall-clock loop. No end-to-end timing, throughput, energy or whole-meeting speedup is measured.
Actual child processes run the test fixture without model weights; this is resource ownership/control verification, not ASR or minutes quality.
No new ASR discovery/model request, GPU component download, app installation or installer build. Q9/Q16 and all release gates remain open.
retained_failures: Initial new test fixture failed to compile because SessionLease has no DerefMut; fixed access through owned session.
Initial strict Clippy failed on an existing nonminimal boolean in phrase.rs; equivalent expression fix and targeted phrase regressions pass.
